title.rendered: SAVE THE DATE | 13th Annual MENA Investor Conference

content.rendered:
𝗦𝗔𝗩𝗘 𝗧𝗛𝗘 𝗗𝗔𝗧𝗘 | 𝟭𝟯𝘁𝗵 𝗔𝗻𝗻𝘂𝗮𝗹 𝗠𝗘𝗡𝗔 𝗜𝗻𝘃𝗲𝘀𝘁𝗼𝗿 𝗖𝗼𝗻𝗳𝗲𝗿𝗲𝗻𝗰𝗲

Arqaam Capital is pleased to announce that our 13th Annual MENA Investor Conference will take place in person in Dubai, at the Ritz-Carlton DIFC, on 3–4 June 2026.

The conference will bring together 75+ leading MENA corporates and regional and international investors through a highly curated program of 1-on-1 meetings and small group sessions, designed to foster meaningful issuer–investor engagement. Further registration details will be shared shortly.

Highlights from our last event (May 2025):
• 619 attendees from across the region and internationally
• 22 panels, private workshops, 4 private lunches, 67 speakers
• 90 corporates representing USD 1 trillion+ market capitalization
• 222 investors across 110 buy-side firms
• 600+ investor interactions

We look forward to welcoming the MENA capital markets community back to Dubai in June 2026!

For enquiries, please contact: 
📩 Paolo Casamassima (paolo.casamassima@arqaamcapital.com)
📩 Mostafa Nagati, CFA (mostafa.nagati@arqaamcapital.com)
📩 Danya Bashir (danya.bashir@arqaamcapital.com)
